items.name: Khao Taan

items.critical_assessment: Excellent synthesis candidate for readers who value craft and regional intent. Less casual than the cheapest Thai specialists, but more intellectually and technically compelling.

items.name: Ma-Makan

items.critical_assessment: Very useful for list diversity and likely a strong neighborhood recommendation, even if evidence here is lighter on technique than for the top BFS-reviewed Thai and Vietnamese entries.

items.name: Duc Anh Quan

items.critical_assessment: A high-conviction candidate despite location. For a food-obsessed audience, this is exactly the kind of worthwhile detour that can justify inclusion.

gaps: Several promising candidates lack full street addresses in the retrieved snippets and need completion in the later Places/verification step: Shaniu's House of Noodles, Tadım Ocakbaşı, El-Reda, Blue Fox, Il Calice, Stari Most, Nußbaumerin.

Regional Chinese is strong on Chinese candidates but skewed toward noodle/dumpling/editorial evidence; a stronger Cantonese/Hong Kong or hotpot-specific candidate did not surface clearly in allowed-domain results.

Southeast Asian coverage is Thai/Vietnamese/Malaysian-heavy; Indonesian, Filipino, Lao, and Burmese options were not well-supported by strong food-specific evidence in the allowed domains during this pass.
Turkish/Middle Eastern/Caucasus has strong Turkish and one Lebanese-Persian candidate, but fewer deeply sourced Georgian/Armenian/Azerbaijani/Persian specialists than ideal.

Mediterranean/European evidence is comparatively thinner and often less food-technical than Chinese/Turkish/Thai coverage; this section may benefit from a second-pass search within allowed domains if more depth is needed.
Fine dining has only two high-confidence candidates that fit the brief without drifting into generic luxury-listing territory.
search_notes: Combined pass constrained to allowed editorial/guide domains only, with no Google Maps use. Highest-yield sources were Berlin Food Stories, Michelin Guide, Mit Vergnügen, and The Berliner. I favored candidates with explicit regional identity, technique cues, or specialist focus, and excluded obvious closure risks where recent source language suggested they were shut (for example, Ernst and Kin Dee were not included as active candidates). Some items are duplicated in spirit across sections, but each candidate was assigned one primary topic_id here while still aiming to preserve the strongest pool for downstream synthesis and Places verification.
